statusNote: Discovery-only. No product logic was changed. Severity is inventory classification for later execution, not a release freeze.

items.title: User uploads served without authentication
evidence: server/src/server.js mounts app.use('/uploads', express.static(UPLOAD_DIR, { maxAge: '7d' })) with no requireAuth
Filenames are UUIDs (saveUpload) — secrecy of URL is the only control
MedicalRecord.imageUrl and lab/imaging/skin flows can persist upload paths
reproduction: Obtain any /uploads/<uuid> URL from a medical record, log, or leaked referrer
GET that URL without Authorization
Observe file bytes returned (PHI/images/PDFs)
items.expected: Owner-authenticated or signed short-lived URLs for health files
items.actual: Public static mount; anyone with the URL can fetch
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Unauthenticated read of user-uploaded health files if URL is known or leaked

items.title: Reward detail screen references undeclared identifiers (likely runtime crash)
evidence: mobile/app/medi-quest/rewards/[id].tsx uses trackQuestEvent, ApiError, QUEST without importing them
tsc: Cannot find name 'trackQuestEvent' / 'QUEST' / 'ApiError'
trackQuestEvent is called on view (line 65) so crash is on screen open, not only on redeem
reproduction: Open /medi-quest/rewards/:id on a JS bundle that evaluates these identifiers
Expect ReferenceError
items.expected: Reward detail loads and redeem works with imported helpers
items.actual: Missing bindings in source; typecheck fails; runtime crash likely
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Economy redeem UX broken; not a client-authoritative coin mint (server still authoritative)

items.title: CycleMoreTracking references undeclared `pregnancy` identifier
evidence: mobile/src/components/cycle/CycleMoreTracking.tsx line ~176 `{pregnancy ? (`
Props type has form, onChange, compact, mode — no pregnancy
tsc: Cannot find name 'pregnancy'
reproduction: Open cycle log more-tracking section
Component render evaluates `pregnancy`
items.expected: Pregnancy-test row gated by an in-scope capability/mode flag
items.actual: Undeclared identifier in render
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Cycle rich-tracking UI may crash; fertility test logging path at risk

items.title: CycleObservationFields imports alcoholLabel which is not exported
evidence: mobile/src/components/cycle/CycleObservationFields.tsx imports alcoholLabel from @/lib/cycleObservations
mobile/src/lib/cycleObservations.ts exports caffeineLabel/energyLabel/exerciseLabel but not alcoholLabel
tsc: Module has no exported member 'alcoholLabel'
reproduction: Load any screen that imports CycleObservationFields
Metro/Hermes missing named export
items.expected: alcoholLabel exported or import removed
items.actual: Broken named import
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Cycle observation UI may fail to load

items.title: AI telemetry persists full prompts and replies with no purge job
evidence: server/src/lib/aiTelemetry.js logs userPrompt and assistantReply onto AiInteraction
withPatientAiContext injects health profile, 14-day metrics, medications, cycle mode
No automated retention/purge found in server jobs
reproduction: Send a Medi chat or lab explain
Inspect Prisma AiInteraction rows
items.expected: Documented retention + minimization; no unbounded PHI in prompts table unless required for quality and access-controlled
items.actual: Unbounded storage of medical prompts/replies; admin can read via /api/admin/ai/interactions/:id
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: PHI retained in operator-readable AI audit table; third-party providers also receive context

items.title: Prisma history is incomplete; phase SQL lives outside migrations
evidence: Only 13 folders under server/prisma/migrations from 2026-08-30 onward; no baseline; no migration_lock.toml
11 phase*.sql files applied via prisma db execute
phase41/phase42 comments: live Neon may have no _prisma_migrations table
reproduction: Compare prisma migrate status vs schema.prisma vs production Neon
items.expected: Single source of schema truth with recorded migrations
items.actual: Drift risk across environments; db push / execute historically used
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Environment schema mismatch can drop constraints (one-ACTIVE episodes) or omit tables

items.title: Mobile TypeScript check fails (123 errors) — inventory, not a green build
evidence: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck exit 2
123 error TS* diagnostics including cycle, rewards, weather .ts extensions, profile, lab, notifications
reproduction: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
items.expected: tsc --noEmit clean for store-facing app
items.actual: 123 errors; Expo runtime may still bundle JS
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Type unsafety can hide ownership/mode bugs; several errors map to likely runtime crashes (RA00-002/003/004)

items.title: Notification Brain unit test failing: re-engagement may fire while session is open
evidence: npm --prefix mobile run test:engage — 37 pass, 1 fail
mediNotificationBrain.test.ts: 'always schedules future re-engagement instead of nagging an open session'
assert.ok(re.every((row) => row.fireAt.getTime() > Date.now())) was falsy
reproduction: npm --prefix mobile run test:engage
items.expected: Re-engagement only scheduled in the future, not during an open session
items.actual: Test asserts at least one candidate fireAt is not in the future
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Possible nagging push while user is in-app; not PHI leak

items.title: Weather client analytics kinds are dropped by server allowlist
evidence: mobile/src/lib/weather/events.ts emits weather_* kinds
server/src/lib/productEvents.js PRODUCT_EVENT_KINDS does not include weather_*
sanitizeProductEventInput returns null for unknown kinds
reproduction: POST /api/push/events/product with kind weather_*
Observe upsert skipped
items.expected: Either accept documented weather events or do not emit them
items.actual: Client thinks it tracks weather; server drops
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Observability gap; kinds themselves are not health values

items.title: DailyUsage, SmsLog, PhoneVerification lack User foreign keys
evidence: Prisma models have userId without @relation to User
reproduction: Delete User; inspect leftover DailyUsage/SmsLog/PhoneVerification rows
items.expected: FK + cascade or documented orphan policy
items.actual: Orphan userId possible
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: OTP/SMS audit rows may outlive the account (or dangle)

items.title: UserRewardEntitlement allows duplicate ACTIVE rows for same key
evidence: No unique (userId, entitlementKey) WHERE status=ACTIVE
reproduction: Adversarial double redeem/entitlement write if application guard fails
items.expected: Partial unique index for one ACTIVE entitlement per key
items.actual: Duplicates possible at schema level
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Value/economy integrity risk if application layer races

items.title: CyclePartnerShare has no uniqueness for one non-revoked invite per owner
evidence: tokenHash unique only; product comment says one active invite
reproduction: Create two shares without revoke if API allows
items.expected: At most one non-revoked share per owner if that is the contract
items.actual: Schema does not enforce it
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Multiple live partner tokens possible — later RA-15 must confirm API guard

items.title: Cycle mode transition has TOCTOU window (read then transaction)
evidence: PUT/PATCH /api/cycle/profile reads current then $transaction for pregnancy/postpartum side effects
reproduction: Two concurrent mode patches (PREGNANCY vs POSTPARTUM vs TRACK)
items.expected: Single transactional compare-and-set for mode + episode
items.actual: Read-then-write; SQL partial unique on ACTIVE episode is the backstop
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Incorrect reproductive-health mode/episode if race wins past application checks

items.title: Mark-taken has no client debounce (local overwrite + sync fire)
evidence: saveDoseLog key medicationId|date|time overwrites; no in-flight lock found
reproduction: Double-tap TAKE on a dose notification or hub row
items.expected: Idempotent single taken event per slot
items.actual: Rapid taps rewrite local log and re-fire sync; DB unique helps server-side
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Misleading taken state / duplicate notifications possible

items.title: After-fetch ownership checks (quest, cycle tags) need adversarial RA-15
evidence: loadQuestForUser: findUnique({ id }) then quest.userId !== userId → 404
cycle tags: findUnique({ id }) then taken.userId !== req.user.id → 403
reproduction: Call claim/tag endpoints with another user's UUID while authenticated as self
items.expected: Owner always in WHERE or equivalent; 404 without existence leak if policy requires
items.actual: Fetch-then-check (currently rejects foreign IDs if helper is used)
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Candidate IDOR if any caller skips the helper; existence leak vs 404/403

items.title: Large share of Pressables lack accessibilityLabel
evidence: Static scan ~666 Pressables, ~261 with accessibilityLabel, ~405 without
Master matrix 811 controls; 763 opening tags without accessibilityLabel attribute (includes admin mutations)
reproduction: VoiceOver/TalkBack on health-metrics, lab, quest chrome, icon-only headers
items.expected: Every interactive control has an accessible name
items.actual: Many icon-only / unlabeled Pressables
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Severe a11y blockers possible on primary flows — later RA must execute

items.title: Microphone permission is declared but no runtime recorder request exists
evidence: app.json NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and RECORD_AUDIO
No Audio.requestPermissionsAsync / recording API usage found
assessmentForm.ts has voiceRecorded flag without recorder
reproduction: Walk assessment; observe no mic prompt despite store strings
items.expected: Request mic only if a feature records; otherwise omit permission
items.actual: Store-facing permission without implementation
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Store review / user-trust mismatch; not an active recording leak

items.title: Partial unique one-ACTIVE episode indexes exist only in SQL migrations, not Prisma schema
evidence: CyclePregnancyEpisode_one_active and CyclePostpartumEpisode_one_active in migration SQL
Not expressible in schema.prisma; db push could omit them
reproduction: Fresh db push without running those migrations; insert two ACTIVE episodes
items.expected: Production always has partial unique; schema documents it as enforced
items.actual: Enforcement depends on which SQL was executed
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Two ACTIVE pregnancy/postpartum episodes would corrupt dating/forecast presentation

items.title: Orphan / redirect-only mobile routes
evidence: /cycle/journal has no inbound push/href; journal is CycleJournalPane on /cycle
/health-metrics/hydration/calendar never linked
/symptoms/conditions Redirect → /symptoms/results
/cycle/pregnancy Redirect → /cycle
reproduction: Deep-link the orphan paths
items.expected: Every screen has a documented entry or is removed
items.actual: Reachable only via typed URL / leftover files

items.title: API inventory method variance (regex 207 vs live Express stack ~217)
evidence: qa/release-audit/RA-00/api-inventory.json count 207
Independent router.stack walk reported 217 including array paths and duplicate registrations
reproduction: Dump Express router.stack in a running process vs JSON artifact
items.expected: Single canonical live dump
items.actual: Two counts; ~10 routes may be array-registered or unconventional
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: Audit completeness risk if a handler is unlisted

items.title: Typecheck: weather modules import .ts extensions (allowImportingTsExtensions)
evidence: Multiple TS5097 in mobile/src/lib/weather/*.ts
reproduction: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
items.expected: Extension-less imports or tsconfig that matches Metro
items.actual: tsc fails; Metro may still resolve

items.title: Most mutations are online-required; optimistic UI can look saved
evidence: Cycle offline queue covers UPSERT_LOG/START/END/FILL only
Mode change, wipe, rewards, quest claim, care-plan, partner, account delete require network
Med doses and hydration are local-first without cycle-style encrypted replay
reproduction: Toggle airplane mode and use save/claim/mode
items.expected: Honest failed-write UX; no fake persistence
items.actual: Mixed; later RA-16 must execute per mutation
items.privacyOrSafetyImpact: User may believe health data saved when it is not
